pages.title: Dire Wolf
pages.text: The dire wolf ($(o)Aenocyon dirus$()) is an extinct canid that lived in North and South America during the Late Pleistocene, until about 13,000 years ago.$(br2)It was similar in size to the largest modern gray wolves but more heavily built, with a powerful bite. Despite its resemblance to the gray wolf, genetic studies place it in a separate lineage.$(br2)Remains of thousands of dire wolves have been found in the La Brea Tar Pits.
